metric_definitions.synthetic_ncc_mean: Mean NCC vs clean over 14k synthetic windows (equal per SNR).
metric_definitions.snr_improvement_mean: Mean output-input SNR gain (dB) on synthetic set.
metric_definitions.dice_mean: Binary Dice of PD segmentation head (synthetic).
metric_definitions.grounded_real_ncc_mean: NCC vs clean Q.Lin window after composite-noise injection + denoise.

selection_criterion: max mean synthetic NCC across 7 SNR levels; tie-break -15 dB
